hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A custom AMM hook backed by Euler lending vaults that implements a concentrated bonding curve. In beforeSwap, it handles all token accounting directly—depositing input tokens into an Euler vault and withdrawing output tokens from another vault—returning a BeforeSwapDelta to bypass standard Uniswap v4 CLAMM liquidity. Standard liquidity addition and donation are blocked via hook reverts.
